verdict.rationale: Gazebo exposes programmatic access via gz-transport (socket-based message passing, remote server control) and documented C++ libraries/plugin APIs, which could be driven by an AI-native agent, but there is no REST/OpenAPI or LLM-friendly API surface (llms.txt, openapi.json, .md docs all 404). missing for 10: no formal public API spec (OpenAPI/REST), no evidence of language-agnostic or HTTP-based API for agentic control, no llms.txt or machine-readable docs.
